newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kookmin Bank launches HK$1 bln FRN. [CORRECTED 09:58 GMT 9/10]
newsitem.headline: Kookmin Bank launches HK$1 bln FRN. [CORRECTED 09:58 GMT 9/10]

text.p: (Corrects to make clear that the European medium term note programme from which the issue has been launched, and not the issue itself, is rated A3)
The following issue was announced by joint lead manager Sakura Finance Asia.

GOV LAW ENGLISH HOME CTRY S. KOREA TAX PROV STANDARD
